response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but their profile does not match the core requirements of this role. C++ experience is limited to a brief stint at National Instruments (~7 months, ended 2015) and a bachelor thesis project, far short of the 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ required. There is no Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was fintech-adjacent but Node.js/GraphQL work in retail investment structuring, not capital markets). The bulk of their experience is web/full-stack with TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang.
strengths: Deep systems-programming background (DLang low-latency, async I/O work at Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based development
Broad polyglot experience with SQL, messaging-style event-driven systems, and DevOps tooling
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, and none recent or on Windows
No Fixed Income, Capital Markets, or Investment Banking domain exposure
No Summit platform experience; SQL Server/Oracle depth not evidenced (skills list only MongoDB/MySQL/SQL)

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering fundamentals and low-latency systems work
